strings.zh: 阿弥陀佛,现在铃铛塔暂不开放。
strings.en: Amitabha. The Bell Tower is{NEWLINE}closed to visitors for now.

strings.zh: 小松『综合考虑最近的这些情况,{NEWLINE}寄出这封抢劫预告函的人{CLEAR}最有可能的就是暗中活动的火箭队。{CLEAR}这个犯罪组织还真是阴魂不散。
strings.en: Morty: Putting together everything{NEWLINE}that’s happened lately, whoever{CLEAR}sent this calling card is most likely{CLEAR}Team Rocket, working in the shadows.{SCROLL}That criminal gang{NEWLINE}just won’t stay dead.

strings.zh: 米那君『水君曾经是保护凤王的卫士。{NEWLINE}如今透明铃铛受到威胁,{CLEAR}我也要像水君那样,{CLEAR}成为保护透明铃铛的卫士。
strings.en: Eusine: Suicune was once the{NEWLINE}guardian that protected Ho-Oh.{SCROLL}Now that the Clear Bell is under threat,{NEWLINE}I’ll be its guardian, just like Suicune.

strings.zh: 米那君『怎么了小松,{NEWLINE}这么匆忙地把我叫过来。{CLEAR}发生什么事了吗？
strings.en: Eusine: What’s wrong, Morty?{NEWLINE}Why call me here in such a{CLEAR}hurry? Has something happened?

strings.zh: 小松『昨天我收到了一封信,{NEWLINE}你看一下。
strings.en: Morty: I received a letter{NEWLINE}yesterday. Take a look.

strings.zh: 小松『{VAR:0103:0}先生,{NEWLINE}我为了能跟凤王心意相通,{CLEAR}偶尔会来铃铛塔特训。{CLEAR}没想到会在这里遇见拟。{SCROLL}小松『既都然来了,要不要跟我{NEWLINE}在这景色别致的铃音小路{CLEAR}来张合影？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Morty: Mr. {VAR:0103:0}, I sometimes come{NEWLINE}to the Bell Tower to train, hoping{CLEAR}to become one with Ho-Oh’s heart. I{CLEAR}never expected to run into you here.{SCROLL}Morty: Since you’re here{NEWLINE}anyway, how about a photo with{CLEAR}me on this lovely Bellchime Trail?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 小松『{VAR:0103:0}小姐,{NEWLINE}我为了能跟凤王心意相通,{CLEAR}偶尔会来铃铛塔特训。{CLEAR}没想到会在这里遇见拟。{SCROLL}小松『既都然来了,要不要跟我{NEWLINE}在这景色别致的铃音小路{CLEAR}来张合影？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Morty: Miss {VAR:0103:0}, I sometimes come{NEWLINE}to the Bell Tower to train, hoping{CLEAR}to become one with Ho-Oh’s heart. I{CLEAR}never expected to run into you here.{SCROLL}Morty: Since you’re here{NEWLINE}anyway, how about a photo with{CLEAR}me on this lovely Bellchime Trail?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 米那君『哦？我看看啊……{SCROLL}米那君『致缘朱市道馆馆主小松：{NEWLINE}透明铃铛是连接人类与凤王的纽带,{CLEAR}你这样的庸才恐怕没有办法{CLEAR}承担起守护透明铃铛的重任。{CLEAR}为了宝物的安全,{CLEAR}我将在明天到缘朱市铃铛塔{CLEAR}取走透明铃铛代为保管,{CLEAR}特此通知。{CLEAR}——寄信人罗凯特•席尔瓦……
strings.en: Eusine: Oh? Let me see...{SCROLL}Eusine: ‘To Morty, Gym Leader{NEWLINE}of Ecruteak City: The Clear Bell is{CLEAR}the bond between people and Ho-Oh.{SCROLL}A mediocrity like you could never{NEWLINE}bear the duty of guarding it.{SCROLL}For the treasure’s safety,{NEWLINE}I shall come to the Bell Tower in{CLEAR}Ecruteak City tomorrow and take{CLEAR}the Clear Bell into my keeping.{SCROLL}Consider yourself notified.{SCROLL}-Rockett Silva’...
strings.notes: Sender 罗凯特•席尔瓦: 罗凯特 is a homophone of ‘Rocket’ (explained in #13); rendered ‘Rockett Silva’ to keep the pun.

strings.zh: 小松『是吗……　{NEWLINE}你也很忙啊。
strings.en: Morty: I understand...{NEWLINE}you must be busy with things.

strings.zh: 相册似乎已经满了,{SCROLL}请在电脑上{NEWLINE}整理一下吧。
strings.en: Your album seems to be full.{SCROLL}Please use a PC to sort out{NEWLINE}the photos in your album.

strings.zh: 小松『好！{NEWLINE}那么,两人排好了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Morty: All right!{NEWLINE}Come and stand next to me.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 小松『嗯,照片照得{NEWLINE}真不错！
strings.en: Morty: Mmmm...{NEWLINE}This is a pretty good picture!

strings.zh: 米那君『呵,这信里的语气{NEWLINE}还真是狂妄无礼至极。{CLEAR}守护透明铃铛是缘朱道馆馆主们{CLEAR}世代相传的职责。{CLEAR}他却寄出这种要抢走铃铛的预告函,{CLEAR}这分明是在挑衅你。
strings.en: Eusine: Heh, the tone of this letter{NEWLINE}is arrogant and rude in the extreme.{SCROLL}Guarding the Clear Bell is a duty{NEWLINE}handed down through generations{CLEAR}of Ecruteak Gym Leaders.{SCROLL}Sending a calling card like this to take{NEWLINE}the bell is a clear challenge to you.

strings.zh: 小松『出于对凤王的尊重和崇拜,{NEWLINE}几百年来从未发生过{CLEAR}偷盗、抢夺透明铃铛的事。{CLEAR}这个寄信人公然发出预告函{CLEAR}要来抢夺透明铃铛,{CLEAR}我觉得这应该不是恶作剧那么简单。{SCROLL}小松『结合最近火箭队{NEWLINE}又开始暗中活动的传闻,{CLEAR}以及寄信人姓名中罗凯特三个字{CLEAR}正是单词Rocket的谐音,{CLEAR}我觉得想来抢透明铃铛的人{CLEAR}很可能就是火箭队。
strings.en: Morty: Out of respect and{NEWLINE}reverence for Ho-Oh, no one{CLEAR}has tried to steal or seize the{CLEAR}Clear Bell in hundreds of years.{SCROLL}For someone to send a calling card{NEWLINE}openly, announcing they’ll take it...{CLEAR}I don’t think this is just a prank.{SCROLL}Morty: There are rumors lately that{NEWLINE}Team Rocket is active again in secret.{SCROLL}And the ‘Rockett’ in the sender’s{NEWLINE}name sounds just like ‘Rocket.’{SCROLL}I think whoever wants the Clear{NEWLINE}Bell is very likely Team Rocket.

strings.zh: 米那君『没问题！你的事就是我的事。{NEWLINE}不管今天来者何人,{CLEAR}都决不能让他碰到透明铃铛。
strings.en: Eusine: No problem! Your{NEWLINE}business is my business.{SCROLL}Whoever comes today, we must never{NEWLINE}let them lay a finger on the Clear Bell.

strings.zh: 小松『好兄弟,我就知道你靠得住！
strings.en: Morty: That’s my friend! I{NEWLINE}knew I could count on you!

strings.zh: 小松『有人来了！
strings.en: Morty: Someone’s coming!

strings.zh: 小松『虽说我已经把透明铃铛{NEWLINE}放到了一个「绝对安全」的地方,{CLEAR}但如果抢夺者是火箭队{CLEAR}那也不能掉以轻心。{CLEAR}所以我需要你陪我在这里值守一天,{CLEAR}以防出现什么意外情况。
strings.en: Morty: I’ve already put the Clear{NEWLINE}Bell somewhere ‘absolutely safe,’{CLEAR}but if the thief is Team Rocket,{CLEAR}we can’t let our guard down.{SCROLL}So I need you to keep watch{NEWLINE}here with me today, just{CLEAR}in case anything happens.

strings.zh: 小松『你这家伙好大的胆啊,{NEWLINE}我本来以为你会秘密潜入,{CLEAR}没想到居然正大光明地闯进来了！
strings.en: Morty: You’ve got some nerve! I{NEWLINE}thought you’d sneak in, but you{CLEAR}just walked right in the front!

strings.zh: 米那君『哈哈,你在想什么呢小松。{NEWLINE}你仔细看看这位是谁？
strings.en: Eusine: Ha ha, what are you thinking,{NEWLINE}Morty? Take a good look at who this is.

strings.zh: 小松『啊！这……{NEWLINE}你是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}先生！
strings.en: Morty: Ah! You’re... Mr. {VAR:0103:0}, the{NEWLINE}League Champion!
strings.notes: Female-player variant is #22 (先生/小姐 only; same English). | RV041: omission: 先生 dropped

strings.zh: 小松『啊！这……{NEWLINE}你是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}小姐！
strings.en: Morty: Ah! You’re... Miss {VAR:0103:0}, the{NEWLINE}League Champion!
strings.notes: Female-player variant of #21. | RV041: omission: 小姐 dropped

strings.zh: 米那君『{VAR:0103:0},我是米那君。{NEWLINE}跟你参加过同一届石英大会的,{CLEAR}你还记得吗？
strings.en: Eusine: {VAR:0103:0}, it’s me, Eusine.{NEWLINE}We competed in the same Indigo{CLEAR}Conference. Do you remember?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『嗯,好久不见啊,米那君。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Yeah, long time no see, Eusine.

strings.zh: 小松『实在抱歉啊{VAR:0103:0}先生,{NEWLINE}我是缘朱市的道馆馆主小松。{CLEAR}因为有人预告要来抢{CLEAR}存放在铃铛塔的透明铃铛,{CLEAR}我就有点戒备过度了。
strings.en: Morty: My sincere apologies,{NEWLINE}Mr. {VAR:0103:0}. I’m Morty,{CLEAR}Ecruteak City’s Gym Leader.{SCROLL}Someone announced they’ll steal the{NEWLINE}Clear Bell kept in the Bell Tower,{CLEAR}so I was a little too much on guard.

strings.zh: 小松『实在抱歉啊{VAR:0103:0}小姐,{NEWLINE}我是缘朱市的道馆馆主小松。{CLEAR}因为有人预告要来抢{CLEAR}存放在铃铛塔的透明铃铛,{CLEAR}我就有点戒备过度了。
strings.en: Morty: My sincere apologies,{NEWLINE}Miss {VAR:0103:0}. I’m Morty,{CLEAR}Ecruteak City’s Gym Leader.{SCROLL}Someone announced they’ll steal the{NEWLINE}Clear Bell kept in the Bell Tower,{CLEAR}so I was a little too much on guard.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『没关系,{NEWLINE}你们刚刚的对话我都听到了,{CLEAR}这是你的职责所在嘛。{CLEAR}其实我在烧焦塔遇到了一个人,{CLEAR}他说要破坏封印之镜、释放三圣兽,{CLEAR}还说如果要他放弃,{CLEAR}除非小松馆主今天亲自去给他解释{CLEAR}破坏镜子并不能解除三圣兽的封印。{CLEAR}否则过了今天,他马上就会砸碎镜子。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: That’s all right. I{NEWLINE}heard what you two were saying.{CLEAR}It’s your job, after all.{SCROLL}Actually, I met someone at the{NEWLINE}Burned Tower. He said he’d break{CLEAR}the Sealing Mirror and free{CLEAR}the three legendary beasts.{SCROLL}He said he’d only give up if Gym{NEWLINE}Leader Morty came in person today{CLEAR}to explain to him that breaking the{CLEAR}mirror won’t undo the beasts’ seal.{SCROLL}Otherwise, once today is over,{NEWLINE}he’ll smash the mirror right away.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『没错。本来我以为{NEWLINE}这就是个普通的闹事者。{CLEAR}但听了你们刚才的说话内容,{CLEAR}我就感觉事情没那么简单。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Exactly. At first I thought{NEWLINE}he was just an ordinary troublemaker.{SCROLL}But after hearing what you{NEWLINE}two just said, I get the{CLEAR}feeling there’s more to it.

strings.zh: 米那君『我为了释放{NEWLINE}封印之镜中的水君,{CLEAR}特地研究过解除封印的办法。{CLEAR}砸碎镜子非但不能释放三圣兽,{CLEAR}反而会将他们永远困在里面！
strings.en: Eusine: I studied how to{NEWLINE}break the seal so I could free{CLEAR}Suicune from the Sealing Mirror.{SCROLL}Smashing the mirror won’t free{NEWLINE}the three legendary beasts. It{CLEAR}would trap them inside forever!

strings.zh: 小松『这是逼我今天去烧焦塔啊,{NEWLINE}偏偏挑今天,非常可疑……
strings.en: Morty: He’s forcing me to go to{NEWLINE}the Burned Tower today. And of all{CLEAR}days, today... Very suspicious...

strings.zh: 米那君『小松,我感觉这是调虎离山。{NEWLINE}把最熟悉铃铛塔的你引开,{CLEAR}然后犯人好趁机潜入偷取铃铛。
strings.en: Eusine: Morty, I think this{NEWLINE}is a diversion. Lure you away, since{CLEAR}you know the Bell Tower best, and the{CLEAR}culprit can sneak in and steal the bell.

strings.zh: 小松『咱俩想到一块去了,{NEWLINE}我也觉得这个在烧焦塔闹事的人{CLEAR}就是在故意引诱我离开铃铛塔。
strings.en: Morty: Great minds think alike. I{NEWLINE}also think this troublemaker at the{CLEAR}Burned Tower is deliberately trying{CLEAR}to draw me away from the Bell Tower.

strings.zh: 米那君『那你的想法是？
strings.en: Eusine: So what’s your plan?

strings.zh: 小松『我刚才说把透明铃铛{NEWLINE}保存到了一个绝对安全的地方。{CLEAR}其实是指把铃铛带在了身上。{CLEAR}现在正好将计就计{CLEAR}去烧焦塔会会这个闹事者。
strings.en: Morty: When I said earlier that I’d put{NEWLINE}the Clear Bell somewhere absolutely{CLEAR}safe, I meant I’m carrying it on me.{SCROLL}So let’s play along with their scheme{NEWLINE}and go meet this troublemaker at the{CLEAR}Burned Tower.
strings.notes: | RV041: meaning: 我刚才说 = 'when I said earlier'; bell was already stored (cf. #17)

strings.zh: 米那君『哈哈,可真有你的。{NEWLINE}这样就算他们潜入铃铛塔{CLEAR}也只能扑个空了。
strings.en: Eusine: Ha ha, that’s just like you.{NEWLINE}Even if they sneak into the Bell Tower,{CLEAR}they’ll come away empty-handed.

strings.zh: 踏着吱吱作响的树叶{NEWLINE}漫步在这古色古香的的小道,{CLEAR}感觉整个人的心情都平静下来了。
strings.en: Walking this old-fashioned path with{NEWLINE}the leaves crunching under my feet...{CLEAR}It makes me feel completely at peace.

strings.zh: 我要在这里拍一组美美的照片！
strings.en: I’m going to take a set of{NEWLINE}really pretty photos here!

strings.zh: 小松『谢谢{VAR:0103:0}先生{NEWLINE}带来的珍贵情报。{CLEAR}我这就跟米那君去烧焦塔看一下{CLEAR}那个闹事的家伙到底是什么来路。
strings.en: Morty: Thank you for the valuable{NEWLINE}information, Mr. {VAR:0103:0}.{SCROLL}I’ll go to the Burned Tower{NEWLINE}with Eusine right now and see what{CLEAR}that troublemaker is really up to.
strings.notes: zh uses 先生 only (no female twin found).

strings.zh: 我要给女朋友拍照片,{NEWLINE}请不要打扰我。
strings.en: I’m taking pictures of my{NEWLINE}girlfriend. Please don’t bother me.

strings.zh: 金色的树叶铺满了林阴小路,{NEWLINE}给青灰的石砖点了一抹炫彩,{CLEAR}这个色调搭配实在是太美了！
strings.en: Golden leaves carpet the shady{NEWLINE}path, adding a splash of color to{CLEAR}the gray-blue stones. The colors{CLEAR}just go together so beautifully!

strings.zh: 米那君『虽然我已经不可能{NEWLINE}再成为水君的训练家,{CLEAR}但身为口袋妖怪训练家的路并未结束。{CLEAR}所以我每周五都会跟小松来铃音小路{CLEAR}进行训练家的修行特性。{CLEAR}{VAR:0103:0}你是最强的训练家,{CLEAR}能与我来一场对战帮我锻炼一下吗？
strings.en: Eusine: I can never be Suicune’s{NEWLINE}Trainer now, but my path as{CLEAR}a Pokémon Trainer isn’t over.{SCROLL}So every Friday I come to Bellchime{NEWLINE}Trail with Morty to train as a Trainer.{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}, you’re the strongest{NEWLINE}Trainer there is. Will you{CLEAR}battle me and help me train?
strings.notes: zh 修行特性 read as a typo for 修行 (training).

strings.zh: 米那君『是吗……那真是太遗憾了。
strings.en: Eusine: I see... That’s a real shame.

strings.zh: 米那君『那么你是希望单打还是双打呢？
strings.en: Eusine: So, would you{NEWLINE}prefer Singles or Doubles?

strings.zh: 单打
strings.en: Singles

strings.zh: 米那君『好的,那我可要上了！
strings.en: Eusine: All right, here I come!

strings.zh: 米那君『真不愧是最强之人,{NEWLINE}我跟你差得实在是太远了。
strings.en: Eusine: You really are the strongest.{NEWLINE}I’m still so far behind you.

strings.zh: 米那君『双打需要至少两只精灵,{NEWLINE}你身上的精灵数量不够！
strings.en: Eusine: A Double Battle needs{NEWLINE}at least two Pokémon. You{CLEAR}don’t have enough with you!
